differences.reason: The current JS source and CIL formatters stringify negative zero as 0; native CoreCLR prints -0 for the same SharpForge DLL and the Roslyn reference. Runtime-owner integration is required.
SharpForge reports extra CS1003 after the expected CS1525 for a missing initializer expression; Roslyn reports CS1525 only. The raw diagnostics remain visible.
Console.ReadLine is outside the current compiler/JS host stdin profile (CS1501). Real native Roslyn execution consumes the fixture stdin and prints Ada; JS adapters explicitly report unsupported.
The CIL verifier rejects emitted System.Environment.get_TickCount as an unimplemented external member. Source VM and both actual native paths produce the explicitly normalized clock output.
